description: M4.1: the SHINY ACCEPT-WITH-ROOM branch of doShinyNode (bundle.deobfuscated.js:80961-80970), which no scenario executed before -- all five shiny resolutions in the M4 matrix were declines. Shares story_gen1_shiny's raw seed and node prefix so the two are a matched accept/decline pair over the same shiny offer at the same checkpoint boundary; the ONLY difference is the final choice index (0 = take the shiny, vs null = flee). Team is 1 at the offer, so the room branch is taken rather than showSwapScreen. Exposed a real port divergence: the source's recordMonOrigin(B) at 80967 receives the still-QUESTION-typed node and sets gotViaQuestion, which the port did not.
